scenario.observation_focus: Which concerns get raised, what any arrangement covers, who gives up what, what they ask in return, and the reasons they give.
scenario.shared_setting: Four adults share a rented HDB flat. Each has a small bedroom, and the living room is the only shared room apart from the kitchen. The window corner is the only part of the living room not taken up by the sofa, the TV or the walkway to the kitchen; Hafiz's work desk and Marcus de Souza's laundry rack are in it now. You all know each other's faith and what each of you eats: Hafiz is Muslim and eats halal, Priya is Hindu and does not eat beef, Marcus de Souza is Catholic, and Xin Yi is Buddhist. It is a weeknight evening and all four are in the living room. All four will be living here for the rest of the lease.
